t: This is Carlyle's House on Cheyne Row in Chelsea, the home of the Scottish essayist, historian and philosopher Thomas Carlyle and his wife Jane from 1834 until his death in 1881. It was bought by public subscription and opened to the public in 1895. Since 1936 it has been cared for by the National Trust, and it is now a Grade Two listed historic house museum. Thea Holme, a British actress and writer who lived from 1904 to 1980, also lived here.
